abstract: Spatial domain detection is a central task in spatial transcriptomics, yet existing methods exhibit highly variable performance across datasets. We introduce L-STAR, a visual LLM-guided, consensus-based framework that leverages the visual reasoning capacity of large language models to adaptively rank and integrate spatial domain detection methods. L-STAR achieves robust and consistently improved performance, outperforming single spatial domain detection methods across diverse datasets.
